findings.title: Inside Cairn: Open Windows into massive AI-Driven Cyber Operations
findings.summary_md: NorForge published its original research on October 19, 2026, identifying over 20 exposed Cairn control panels used for malicious autonomous operations. The report details how threat actors directed AI agents toward persistent access and financial theft, with the largest cluster comprising over 1,100 attack projects across 14 dashboards targeting e-commerce in the US, Japan, and Australia.

findings.title: AI Agents Are Hacking Online Retailers for $25 a Company
findings.summary_md: Gambit Security released findings on September 22, 2026, documenting an ongoing campaign using three open-source AI harnesses to compromise online retailers at marginal cost. The research recovered the operator's staging server, reconstructed attacks from July through September 2026, and accounted for at least 27 compromised companies, over 600,000 unexpired credit card details, and automated database-wipe instructions after data extraction.
